evidence.text: Write Q = hQrefh⁻¹ and B = h⁻¹dh, then decompose B into integer eigenspaces of ad Qref. Projecting the sigma-model equations onto these charge modes converts them into algebraic restrictions and differential equations. Flatness of B supplies the corresponding Bianchi identities.
